facts.business: DCM Limited operates in the real estate and grey iron casting (engineering) segments, with the engineering division under lockout since October 2019.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on going concern due to JDA advance exceeding current assets; Emphasis of Matter on lockout legality and non-provision of wages aggregating Rs. 7,964 lakhs.

key_risks: Engineering Division under lockout since October 22, 2019, with no production activities
Going concern uncertainty due to JDA advance of Rs. 5,000 lakhs exceeding current assets by Rs. 4,161.54 lakhs
Non-provision of wages for lockout period aggregating Rs. 7,964 lakhs
Suspended development license for Hisar land project under JDA
Short-term funds of Rs. 4,161.54 lakhs used for long-term purposes
Industry challenges: rising input costs, energy prices, skilled manpower shortage, EV transition reducing demand for conventional cast components
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act and disclosed in notes to standalone financial statements as required by applicable Indian accounting standards.
